name: Wren Alder
tagline: Wildlife, landscapes, cities and outdoor portraits, made from a small cabin in the North Cascades.
responseTime: I reply within two working days.

portrait.alt: A photographer holding a camera in a sunlit field of dry grass
portrait.name: wren-in-the-field.jpg

intro: I spent ten years photographing animals that didn't want to be photographed. It turns out that's good training for families.
story:
Most of my year is spent outside, waiting. Waiting for a fox to come back along a fence line, for cloud to lift off a ridge, for a city to go quiet at five in the morning.

People sessions work the same way. I don't pose you. We pick a place you love, go at the hour when the light is kind, and walk. I stay out of the way until something real happens, and then I take the picture.

I work alone, so the person you write to is the person who turns up. Sessions happen anywhere within a day's drive of the Cascades, and further if you have a good reason.
